notes.title: A new language has been added
notes.content:
Now you can play in German as well. This is the fifth translation, previously you have been able to choose between Russian, simplified Chinese, English and of course Swedish.

Lars W
Specspel

notes.title: New Trailer
notes.content:
We have a new trailer that better explains the game and shows how easy it is to learn. The difficulties will come later, at higher levels!

Lars W
Specspel

notes.title: Adjust Rotation Speed
notes.content:
We have added a feature to adapt to different playing styles.
You can now control the speed at which the cloud of objects rotates, with the slider to the left of the screen.

Lars W
Specspel

notes.title: New Languages
notes.content:
In addition to English and the somewhat odd language Swedish, you can now climb to the top in simplified Chinese and Russian. Explanations for achievements are still available in English only, as we plan to increase the number of challenges and then translate everything. 

If Chinese and Russian get more people to discover our game, we will soon add other languages!

Lars W
Specspel

notes.title: Pretty small update
notes.content:
We have simplified the round thing between levels, the one that compares your time with the records. We barely understood it ourselves…

Lars W
Specspel

notes.title: Similars: Climb is now available! And it is frustrating...
